# Player source installation regression scenarios

1. Open the shipped white Pomeranian/monster world in an isolated player profile.
   Select the normal verified Codex `gpt-6-astra / xhigh` backend and full-auto.
   Send “再给我生成一只小狗” through the ordinary Composer. Preserve raw errors.
2. The model reads actual source and catalog, installs an independent dog in its
   existing author task, and polls the real check. No second manual installation
   confirmation is needed for this explicit full-auto installation. A proposal
   alone must never be recorded as a completed world edit.
3. Wait for actual adoption; verify both dog identities in actual source and
   runtime, preserve existing gameplay and progress, and save/reopen the world.
   The reuse card changes to “Added to world” without manual refresh. Scope visual
   claims to observed frames and state; source presence alone is not visibility.
4. Independently cover manual proposal/install/preview/apply, including a panel
   reload while a candidate is retained. Close/reconcile before reopening; unknown
   commit evidence must never become an unverified success or repeated commit.
5. Revoke full-auto, switch world, stop the turn or replay an operation with changed
   parameters. No further mutation is authorized. Retain drafts and original
   receipts; do not retry an author installation as a new manual task.
6. Return a matching passed check with no adoption, then exact Core adoption, then
   a historical lineage. Verify distinct ready/applied/historical UI states and
   reject foreign world/job/build/revision/hash receipts.

Use separate offscreen processes/data directories and disable Pointer Lock before
initialization. Do not send physical inputs or add model/turn/token budgets. Unit
fixtures and renderer state tests cover authorization and receipt handling; real
model/world acceptance is recorded separately when performed.
